### Free-text responses

```{r}
#| echo: false
source(file.path(book_root, "R/recodes/org2can_recode.R"))

cleaned_data <- process_text_codes_with_allocation(
  filter = FILTER,
  question_code = "org2can",
  recode_map = org2can_recode_map, 
  header = "Benefits",
  other = TRUE,
  cache_id = "org2can"
)

cleaned_data$summary_table
```

The raw-to-category allocation table for this question is in @sec-appendix-recoding.
